name: Complete Blood Count
description: Complete Blood Count (CBC) measuring cellular elements of peripheral blood including red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets, red cell indices, and differential leukocyte count.
patientPreparation: No special fasting required under standard conditions.
collectionInstructions: Collect whole blood in EDTA tube. Invert tube gently 8-10 times to prevent microclots. Do not shake.
laboratoryInstructions: Analyze on automated hematology analyzer within 6 hours of collection. Examine blood film if automated flags are present.
reportDescription: Complete Blood Count providing quantitative evaluation of erythrocyte, leukocyte, and thrombocyte parameters.
interpretationGuidance: Clinical correlation is recommended. Values outside normal reference intervals may indicate anemia, infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorders.

name: Liver Function Test
description: Liver Function Test (LFT) panel evaluating hepatic cellular integrity, excretory function, and synthetic capacity through serum bilirubin, transaminases, alkaline phosphatase, and total proteins.
specimenContainer: SST Vacutainer (Gold/Yellow Top) or Plain Clot Activator (Red Top)
patientPreparation: Overnight fasting of 10-12 hours is recommended. Avoid alcohol consumption for 24 hours prior to blood collection.
collectionInstructions: Collect venous blood in SST or plain tube. Allow blood to clot for 30 minutes at room temperature before centrifugation. Centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes to separate serum. Avoid hemolysis.
laboratoryInstructions: Serum must be free from hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia. Analyze on automated clinical chemistry analyzer. Store serum refrigerated at 2-8°C if analysis is delayed.
reportDescription: Liver Function Panel assessing liver enzyme activities and protein synthesis.
interpretationGuidance: Elevated transaminases (AST, ALT) indicate hepatocellular injury. Elevated ALP and bilirubin indicate cholestasis or biliary obstruction. Alterations in total protein and albumin reflect hepatic synthetic capacity.

name: Kidney Function Test
description: Kidney Function Test (KFT) panel evaluating renal function, filtration capacity, and electrolyte balance through serum creatinine, blood urea, electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride), and total calcium.
specimenContainer: SST Vacutainer (Gold/Yellow Top) or Plain Clot Activator (Red Top)
patientPreparation: No special fasting required unless specified by the physician. Avoid strenuous exercise prior to blood collection.
collectionInstructions: Collect venous blood in SST or plain tube. Allow blood to clot for 30 minutes at room temperature before centrifugation. Centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes to separate serum. Avoid hemolysis.
laboratoryInstructions: Serum must be non-hemolyzed. Gross hemolysis interferes with potassium and calcium measurements. Analyze on automated clinical chemistry analyzer. Store serum refrigerated at 2-8°C if analysis is delayed.
reportDescription: Kidney Function Panel assessing renal excretory capacity and electrolyte balance.
interpretationGuidance: Elevated creatinine and urea indicate reduced renal filtration capacity. Electrolyte alterations (sodium, potassium, chloride) reflect fluid balance, acid-base status, and tubular function. Serum calcium evaluates mineral metabolism.
